title: Xanthippe
html_source:
Socrates' wife.

She empties a chamber pot over Socrates in this 16th emblem print.

anchor.prefix:
ooted, bald, eared and assiduous. 

 — A shrew, John Eglinton said shrewdly, is not a useful portal of discovery, one should imagine. What useful discovery did Socrates learn from
anchor.suffix:
? 

1922#182

 — Dialectic, Stephen answered: and from his mother how to bring thoughts into the world. What he learnt from his other wife Myrto (absit nomen!), Socratididion's Epi
